summary: 1951 steel fire tower near West Point, Ohio; registers list it standing, but other sources say it may have been moved or removed.

facts.design: 80-foot steel tower with a glassed-in cabin
facts.status_note: Sources disagree: NHLR and a statewide list say standing; another register says it may have moved to Beaver Creek State Park, and a Forest Lookouts page ends with the word 'Removed'.

events.note: Steel tower reported nearing completion in late April 1951; one of ten being erected by the Division of Forestry
Daylight lookout for critical fire seasons; Floyd H. Beatty named to be towerman for fall 1951
Tower spotted a grass fire on a Tuesday afternoon (Tuesday was October 30, 1951), reported in an item dated October 31, 1951; Wellsville volunteers quelled it
Margaret Ronshak began as observer in spring 1967; a March 6, 1968 item still names her at the Madison Township fire tower
Registered September 3, 2014 as US 1578, OH 24 (West Point Tower Site)

notes_for_editor: Status is disputed and unresolved. NHLR (2014 registration) and the FFLOS Ohio list say standing; the FFLOS West Point Tower Site record says it may have moved to Beaver Creek State Park; the Forest Lookouts page ends with an undated 'Removed'. Location naming also differs: NHLR says Beaver Creek State Forest, FFLOS says Beaver Creek State Park. No source found on current access, rental or condition, so access is omitted. The record's height_m 24.4 matches the 80-foot figure, but that is the overall tower height, not height to the cab floor, so height_m is not repeated in facts. The record had no built year; 1951 comes from the 1951 newspaper transcripts on the Forest Lookouts page. Newspaper quotes are from a transcript, not a scan, so check the original East Liverpool Review and Evening Review items if the story goes to print. The grass-fire item is dated October 31, 1951 and says the fire was on Tuesday afternoon; the story gives the item date, not a fire date. Verification 2026-10-08: the 1,447-foot Round Knob, glassed-in cabin and March 6, 1968 items all match the transcript.
